mapper.select: select call_record_id callRecordId,lead_id leadId,todo_id todoId,call_channel callChannel, external_call_id externalCallId,started_at startedAt,ended_at endedAt,duration_seconds durationSeconds, call_result callResult,recording_file_object_id recordingFileObjectId,manual_notes manualNotes, provider_summary_hash providerSummaryHash,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,create_by createBy from biz_lead_call_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select review_id reviewId,lead_id leadId,reason_code reasonCode,sales_explanation salesExplanation, submitted_by submittedBy,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewer_id reviewerId,review_result reviewResult, review_comment reviewComment,reviewed_at reviewedAt,system_default systemDefault,todo_id todoId, status,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_invalid_review where review_id=#{reviewId}

select review_id reviewId,lead_id leadId,reason_code reasonCode,sales_explanation salesExplanation, submitted_by submittedBy,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewer_id reviewerId,review_result reviewResult, review_comment reviewComment,reviewed_at reviewedAt,system_default systemDefault,todo_id todoId, status,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_invalid_review where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: update biz_lead_invalid_review set reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},review_result=#{result},review_comment=#{comment},reviewed_at=sysdate(), system_default=#{systemDefault},status='COMPLETED',row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where review_id=#{reviewId} and status='PENDING' and row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: select retry_record_id retryRecordId,lead_id leadId,plan_id planId,window_code windowCode, attempt_no attemptNo,contact_result contactResult,next_window_code nextWindowCode,todo_id todoId, call_record_id callRecordId,occurred_at occurredAt,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_retry_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select quality_record_id qualityRecordId,lead_id leadId,sales_user_id salesUserId,reason_code reasonCode, reviewer_id reviewerId,source_todo_id sourceTodoId,source_review_id sourceReviewId, quality_type qualityType,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_quality_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select dead_pool_log_id deadPoolLogId,lead_id leadId,action_type actionType,reason_code reasonCode, reason_detail reasonDetail,from_disposition fromDisposition,to_disposition toDisposition, operator_id operatorId,source_todo_id sourceTodoId,action_time actionTime,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_dead_pool_log where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: update biz_business_tag_rel set confirm_status=#{confirmStatus},confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at=sysdate(),update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where tag_rel_id=#{tagRelationId} and business_type='LEAD' and business_id=#{leadId} and confirm_status in ('PENDING','CORRECTED')
mapper.select: select plan_id from todo_schedule_plan where business_type='LEAD' and business_id=#{leadId} and status='ACTIVE' order by plan_id desc limit 1

select policy_id policyId,sales_dept_id salesDeptId,source_code sourceCode,business_type businessType, retry_rule_json retryRuleJson,status,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_assignment_policy where sales_dept_id=#{salesDeptId} and business_type='LEAD' and status='ACTIVE' and source_code in (#{sourceCode},'*') order by case when source_code=#{sourceCode} then 0 else 1 end,policy_id limit 1
select user_id from biz_lead_assignment_policy_candidate where policy_id=#{policyId} and status='ACTIVE' order by sort_order,user_id
